transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?
I don't know... I'm just so worn out. Just going from the bedroom to the kitchen... it feels like I've been hauling lumber all day. And resting doesn't give me anything back. That's about it.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah... I suppose so. I used to do a few things. Choir... pickup ball. Used to work on cars a bit, or grill out for the family. But... I don't know. I just can't make myself care enough to do any of it now. I don't show up. I don't even answer people's texts anymore. Just... don't have it in me.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been... I guess about four months now. Started around the time my wife went back to working full-time. So... I'm just here by myself most of the week.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or that you’ve let people down lately?

Yeah... I guess so. I just... I keep thinking about how I've failed everybody. My wife, the kids... even the church. It's just... I don't know. Sometimes it feels like all the bad things happening lately... like it's a punishment. Because I'm not... I'm not the man I'm supposed to be.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently? Or have you been having trouble sleeping, like waking up in the middle of the night or early in the morning?
I don't know. I guess I haven't really noticed. Food is just... food. And sleep... I just kind of lay there. I don't really pay attention to the time.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or have you felt restless or fidgety lately?
Yeah... slower, I guess. Everything is just... it's like trying to move through mud. And... even talking. I hear what people ask me, it just... it takes a long time to get the words out.
Have you had any thoughts about not wanting to live anymore or hurting yourself?

I... yeah. The thought just... keeps coming. That I should just be dead. I don't... I don't like being alone right now. It scares me. Because I start thinking I might... actually do something. To make that happen.
Have you ever felt this way before, like this kind of depression, or is this the first time you've experienced something like this?
No... I don't think so. Not... not like this. First time, I guess.
Have you ever had a period of time before where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble functioning like you have been lately?
No... I mean, I just said... this is the first time. I haven't... it hasn't been like this before.
